run_qinco_evaluation: run the QINCo model evaluation pipeline on a dataset like bigann1M with FAISS knn search
encode_database_vectors: encode database vectors using a loaded QINCo model with configurable batch size and float16 support
decode_qinco_codes: decode QINCo compressed codes back to reconstructed vectors using the model and batch settings
evaluate_recall_at_rank: evaluate 1-recall at ranks 1, 10, and 100 by comparing ground truth against FAISS knn results
load_qinco_model: load a QINCo model from disk with optional float16 conversion and device mapping via torch.load
